sentences.en: Barcodes have made getting through the checkout much faster.
sentences.zh: 条形码让结账过程快了很多。

sentences.en: We repress the fact that we eat animals rather than barcoded containers from the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我们压抑着这样一个事实，即我们吃的是动物而不是超市里出售的包装食品（而非直接说成是‘带有条形码的容器’更符合中文表达习惯）

sentences.en: The cashier scanned the barcode on each item before placing it in the bag.
sentences.zh: 收银员扫描了每个商品上的条码，然后将其放入袋中。
